t: This is Stamford Bridge, the football stadium in Fulham, in West London, and the home of Premier League club Chelsea. It holds just over forty thousand people, which makes it the twelfth-largest football ground in England. The man who designed it was Archibald Leitch, a Scottish architect best known for planning football stadiums across Great Britain and Ireland. The photographer Gjon Mili, born in Albania and later working in America, is recorded as having died here. He is best known for his work in Life magazine, where he photographed artists such as Picasso.
